title: Sorting Race
summary: Bubble vs insertion vs merge vs quick, stepped as generators so every comparison is visible.
prompt: Sorting visualizer racing four algorithms side by side. Each algorithm is a generator yielding after every compare/write so one frame can advance N ops; show comparison and write counters plus finish order.
notes: Generators keep the algorithm bodies readable and make the race fair: every panel gets the same ops-per-frame budget. Same shuffled input for all four.
